control_statement: QNT-001 was publicly disclosed and published years before the Osaka 2025 access inflection. Therefore that later access event is temporally incapable of causing the earlier QNT-001 publication and must act as a placebo if an access-clustering model attempts to associate them.
falsification_use: Detects retrospective or overly broad access attribution. A valid temporal model must reject causal direction from the 2025 access inflection to the 2020/2021 QNT-001 result.
limitations: The control does not compare identical hardware systems or institutions.
It tests temporal direction and broad quantum-access attribution, not whether earlier access elsewhere contributed to QNT-001.
It must not be used to infer anything about Osaka downstream outputs after 2025-07-28.
